title: 介绍丰田 Woven City 合作试点的参与方式
topic: 如何用真实试点收集反馈并改进产品？

source.title: Toyota Woven City Officially Launches as a Test Course for the Future of Mobility
source.readingTitle: A pilot where companies build and residents respond
source.section: 丰田合作创新试点发布
source.type: 丰田合作创新试点发布
source.context: 丰田于 2025 年 9 月公布的 Woven City 启动计划
source.date: 2025-09-25（启动公告；约 300 人为第一阶段预期）
paragraphs: A mobility service can look promising in a presentation and still fail in daily use. Toyota’s Woven City is designed as a real community where companies can develop and test products, while residents experience them in everyday settings.

The project brings together two groups. Companies, startups and research teams develop products and services. Residents and visitors, called Weavers, try those ideas and share feedback based on what works for them. Toyota expects the first phase to accommodate about 300 residents.

Testing in a lived-in setting creates a useful feedback loop. A team can observe how a service fits into a routine, ask users what caused friction and revise the design before expanding it. The goal is to turn collaboration into products and services that can serve people beyond the test city.
translations: 一项移动服务在简报中看起来很有前景，但在日常使用中仍可能失败。丰田的 Woven City 被设计成一个真实社区，让企业开发和测试产品，居民则在日常环境中体验。
这个项目汇聚两类参与者。企业、初创公司和研究团队负责开发产品与服务。被称为 Weavers 的居民和访客会试用这些方案，并根据实际体验分享回馈。丰田在 2025 年 9 月的启动公告中预计，第一阶段最终可容纳约 300 名居民；这是当时公布的计划预期。
在真实生活环境中测试，可以形成有效的回馈循环。团队能观察服务如何融入日常生活，询问使用者遇到哪些不便，并在扩大应用前修改设计。目标是把合作成果转化为能服务测试城市以外人群的产品和服务。
fullTextParagraphs: A mobility service can look promising in a presentation and still fail in daily use. Toyota’s Woven City is designed as a real community where companies can develop and test products, while residents experience them in everyday settings.

The project brings together two groups. Companies, startups and research teams develop products and services. Residents and visitors, called Weavers, try those ideas and share feedback based on what works for them. Toyota expects the first phase to accommodate about 300 residents.

At launch, 20 Inventors were taking part. The partners bring different capabilities, from manufacturing and software to consumer products and services. Their work ranges from mobility and delivery to food, coffee and home environments.

Testing in a lived-in setting creates a useful feedback loop. A team can observe how a service fits into a routine, ask users what caused friction and revise the design before expanding it. The goal is to turn collaboration into products and services that can serve people beyond the test city.

A partner invitation should make the roles and next step clear: what the pilot will test, what the company will contribute, what residents will do and how the team will use feedback. That gives every participant a practical reason to join.
verifiedFacts: Woven City launched as a real-world test course for mobility and Toyota’s transformation.
Inventors include enterprises, startups, entrepreneurs and research institutions that develop and test services.
在 2025 年 9 月启动公告中，丰田称第一阶段最终预计容纳约 300 名居民；这是当时预期，不代表当前入住人数。
At launch, 20 Inventors were participating and an accelerator program invited additional proposals.

notes.phrase: a real community where companies can develop and test products
notes.meaning: 企业能在其中开发和测试产品的真实社区
notes.explain: where 引导地点从句，说明试点场景具备什么用途。
notes.example: We need a real setting where teams can test the new service.

notes.phrase: share feedback based on what works for them
notes.meaning: 根据实际使用效果分享回馈
notes.explain: based on 表示回馈的依据；what works for them 指对使用者有效的部分。
notes.example: Customers share feedback based on what works for them.

notes.explain: before + 动名词，说明先验证、后扩大的顺序。
notes.example: We will review the pilot before expanding it.

scenario.title: 虚构练习：测试新的医院接驳服务
english: A transport company is piloting an on-demand shuttle for hospital visitors.
The company will provide vehicles and dispatch software; visitors will test pickup points and report delays.
Write three sentences for the hospital partner: test goal, participant roles and how feedback will be used.
chinese: 一家交通公司正在试行面向医院访客的按需接驳车。
公司提供车辆和调度软件；访客测试上车点并回报延误情况。
请给医院合作方写三句话：说明测试目标、参与者角色和回馈用途。

firstAttempt.prompt: 请根据丰田 2025 年 9 月的启动公告给合作伙伴写三句话：说明试点目的、企业与居民各自的角色，以及居民反馈如何影响后续设计。
firstAttempt.sample: At its September 2025 launch, Toyota described Woven City as a real-world test course for mobility. Inventors develop products and services, while residents and visitors, known as Weavers, experience them and share feedback. Teams can use that feedback to revise a design before considering whether to expand it beyond the test city.
firstAttempt.rationale: 把信息限定在 2025 年启动公告：先说测试目的，再区分 Inventors 与 Weavers 的角色，最后说明反馈怎样进入设计迭代。

words.example: The team will run a pilot in two cities.
words.translation: 团队将在两座城市开展试点。

words.example: Pilot participants will test the service for four weeks.
words.translation: 试点参与者将测试这项服务四周。

words.example: A short feedback loop helps the team revise the design.
words.translation: 快速的回馈循环有助于团队修改设计。
